summary: Aeromexico furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited third-quarter 2026 earnings release plus July, August and September 2026 traffic releases. Total revenue reached $1.6 billion, up 13.6% year over year, with adjusted EBITDAR of $389.2 million (24.0% margin), operating income of $189.6 million (11.7% margin), and liquidity of $1.2 billion (20.7% of LTM revenue). No transaction, stake, price per share or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine foreign private issuer earnings and traffic report, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
